rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Ohm's Law applies to all conductors.' ✅ It is valid only for *ohmic conductors* (where V is proportional to I, like metallic resistors), not for non-ohmic devices like diodes or transistors.  ·  ❌ 'Ohm's Law defines Resistance (R=V/I).' ✅ Resistance is a *property* of the conductor (geometry/material); Ohm's law states that *for some materials*, R remains constant regardless of V or I.
